summary: This note describes the 1967 animated television series Spider-Man, based on the Marvel comic book created by Stan Lee and designed by Steve Ditko. It was a joint Canadian (voice acting) and American (animation) production. The first two seasons aired on ABC, the third was syndicated, and the series starred Paul Soles as Peter Parker.
one_line: A 1967–1970 animated TV series based on the Spider-Man comic book, produced in Canada and the United States.
key_facts: Spider-Man (1967 TV series) was the original animated TV series based on the Spider-Man comic book series.
The Spider-Man comic book series was created by writer Stan Lee and designed by artist Steve Ditko.
The series was jointly produced in Canada (voice acting) and the United States (animation).
The first two seasons of Spider-Man (1967 TV series) aired on the ABC television network.
The third season of Spider-Man (1967 TV series) was distributed in syndication.
Grantray-Lawrence Animation produced the first season of Spider-Man (1967 TV series).
Krantz Films in New York City produced seasons two and three of Spider-Man (1967 TV series).
Paul Soles starred as Peter Parker (Spider-Man) in Spider-Man (1967 TV series).
Spider-Man (1967 TV series) ran from September 9, 1967, to June 14, 1970.
